title: preview preflight job result

state.description: The worst state of the checks.

check.description: The check: reachability, robots, sitemaps, pages, egress or cms (new names may be added).

code.description: <area>.<code>, e.g. http.404, robots.disallowed, egress.blocked; the admin shows its Swedish text and remediation.

target.description: The URL or host the entry is about.

facts.description: Small facts for the text (counts, status codes); never page content.

estimatedPages.description: Crawl: in-scope sitemap URLs, compared with maxPages.

cms.description: The CMS preset recognised on the start host (e.g. sitevision).

description: Result of a preview job of kind preflight (connectors design §2.2; admin design §5.4 step 4): the worst state and one entry per check. A fail blocks the save, a warn explains.
